desired_state.responsibility: Observe managed services and external provider CLIs with explicit principal and connection-presence evidence; execute explicit adoption/connection recipes, then re-probe the effective principal and return machine-readable proof.
anti_responsibilities: claim operator authentication as runtime-principal authentication
install or mutate services from the status command
hide interactive provider login inside an opaque helper
expose secret values in argv, stdout, stderr, or proof
execute install or login side effects from the plan command
treat operator-local auth as runtime-principal adoption
invent a provider install path that is not yet modeled

reconcile: pure decision from desired_state.integrations vs observed EcosystemIntegrationsStatus; adopt/connect only if plan approved and principal connection observed without secret exposure
